content: निरूप् €10 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To see, perceive, mark or observe carefully; न च महावने पन्था निरूपितः <ls>K. 120</ls>. .²2 To investigate, examine, look out for, search. .²3 To fix upon, determine, settle, resolve. .²4 To choose, select, appoint. .²5 To reflect, consider. .²6 To act, represent dramatically, gesticulate. .²7 To perform.
